SELECT A.UUID uuid, A.INF_ID infId, A.SYS_CODE sysCode, A.SEQ_NO seqNo, A.IP_ADDRESS ipAddress, A.PORT port, A.RTN_CODE rtnCode, A.RTN_MSG rtnMsg, A.DO_STATUS doStatus, A.TRAN_DATE tranDate, A.TRAN_TIME tranTime, A.REQUEST_DATA requestData, A.RESPONSE_DATA responseData FROM INTERF_RISK_LOG A
STR_TO_DATE(A.TRAN_DATE,'%Y-%m-%d') >= STR_TO_DATE(#{starTranDate},'%Y-%m-%d')
AND STR_TO_DATE(A.TRAN_DATE,'%Y-%m-%d') <= STR_TO_DATE(#{endTranDate},'%Y-%m-%d')
AND A.INF_ID LIKE CONCAT_ws('', '%',#{infId}, '%')
AND A.SEQ_NO LIKE CONCAT_ws('', '%',#{seqNo}, '%')
AND A.DO_STATUS = #{doStatus}
AND A.SYS_CODE LIKE CONCAT_ws('', '%',#{sysCode}, '%')
AND A.REQUEST_DATA LIKE CONCAT_ws('', '%',#{requestData}, '%')
AND A.RESPONSE_DATA LIKE CONCAT_ws('', '%',#{responseData},'%')
ORDER BY A.CREATE_TIME DESC
